summary: Iteration 5 frontend-only testing of the Learn page. Verified multi-table selection (toggle, setOne via double-click, no-op when deselecting the last one, counter), multi-table view rendering of per-table lists and combined tips, in-depth tableTips content (×3 digit-sum example '1+2+3 = 6', ×9 digit-sum trick, ×11 alternating sum rule), 3D flip flashcards with framer-motion rotateY toggling 0↔180°, flash deck size 12×N, solid Knew/Missed buttons (bg-emerald-500 / bg-rose-500 + text-white, no opacity classes), and multi-table headers in Choices/Skip/Drill views. All checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: tableTips in /app/frontend/src/lib/game.js is ~100 lines of a single object literal — acceptable, but consider moving to a separate data file if it grows further.
flashcardSet uses Math.random (non-seeded) shuffle; acceptable for Learn mode but would be non-deterministic if ever reused in daily/boss contexts.
TableView / SingleTable both render [data-testid=learn-table-list-{n}]; no duplicate collisions since a table is only rendered once per selection, but worth keeping in mind.

AnimatePresence key ${tab}-${tables.join(',')} triggers a full remount on every table toggle — flashcards are therefore reset to card 0 whenever the user toggles a table mid-session. Intentional per state reset in useEffect, but could surprise users mid-deck.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 passed all functional checks. Key verifications: learn-pick-N single-click toggles, double-click sets only one, last-selected click is a no-op; TableView renders learn-table-list-N for every selected table and a combined tips card; FlashView's inner motion.div has style transform:'none' initially and becomes 'rotateY(180deg)' after a click on flash-card (give ~600-700ms). flash-knew uses bg-emerald-500 text-white, flash-missed uses bg-rose-500 text-white — both fully opaque. Skip/Choices/Drill all accept the tables array and show '{n} tables' when >1. No backend changes in this iteration.
